register.title: Create an account
register.intro: We ask for as little as possible: an email address to sign in, a name of your choosing, and a password. Nothing about your nationality or your administrative situation.
register.displayNameHelp: Any name you like. It does not have to be your legal name.
register.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, including one letter and one digit.
register.consent: I have read and accept the privacy policy.
register.consentRequired: Your consent is required to create an account.
register.emailTaken: An account already exists for this email address.
